# Rust standard-library notices

`COPYRIGHT-library.html` is the unmodified library-only copyright/license
notice supplied with the official x86_64 Linux Rust 1.99.1 toolchain used for
this release (`rustc 1.99.1`, commit `58cf8f9c3`, 13 October 2026). It includes
upstream standard-library and bundled library-component attribution and license
texts. It is a conservative cross-platform superset; not every listed component
is linked into this Linux executable. The Rust compiler and its entire toolchain
are not distributed by this project.

Source project: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/tree/1.99.1 . These notices
supplement the separately collected Cargo package inventory. Keep this directory
with redistributed backend archives. Third-party terms remain their owners'.
